mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses the risk-free rate, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations and triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline >0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO and HOUST both decline by >0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, as observed in the 2015-2019 tightening cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) directly reflects weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 450,000 units indicates a weakening residential sector that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 450.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a robust economic expansion with rising corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL and INDPRO both rise by >0.2% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A supply-constrained economy (INDPRO < 100) leads to higher prices for goods and services, which boosts corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.
